name: Asish Mohapatra
current_role: Co-Founder and CEO, OfBusiness (OFB Tech), Gurugram
profile: IIT Kharagpur B.Tech and ISB MBA who worked at ITC, McKinsey and Matrix Partners India before co-founding OfBusiness in 2015, a tech platform combining raw-material procurement with credit for SMEs. OfBusiness became a SoftBank-backed unicorn; its lending arm Oxyzo is run by his wife and co-founder Ruchi Kalra.
interesting_fact: OfBusiness started by supplying steel for guardrail manufacturing; Mohapatra has said the founders faced 73 investor rejections in 2016 before the company went on to become a unicorn.
deep_cut_fact: Born while his parents were researchers at IIT Kharagpur, he grew up in Cuttack, Odisha (and says he loves Cuttack's thunka puri); he traces his entrepreneurial spark to a Class 3 school essay he researched on Walt Disney.

public_contacts.value: https://www.ofbusiness.com/about/news (Press & Media page with media kit)

notes: No published press email; only a general support address (getsupport@ofbusiness.in) on the company site. Team page links his LinkedIn. Has done podcasts (e.g. KPMG Startup Speakeasy).
